en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a central European town square with a large church featuring a tall clock tower and spire. Trees and a few town buildings surround the square, and in the distant background another large building or castle is visible on a hill. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Frauenstein in the Saxon Ore Mountains and refers to the market square.
